scientific_integrity: All fourteen coefficient rows were computed by exhaustive finite-field arithmetic from the defining equations and checked with a standalone standard-library program; no generic Newton-polygon theorem is asserted beyond F4 coefficients. Independent audit and historical priority review are not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact Weil-polynomial distribution counts all 192 nonzero-leading-coefficient parameter tuples over F4, not curve isomorphism classes. It does not classify the full algebraic-closure family, all isogenies, polarizations, or larger finite extension coefficient fields.
title: Complete \(\mathbb F_4\) isogeny spectrum of a genus-five Artin–Schreier family
